name: Kurumagaeshi-zakura (the carriage-turning cherry), Kyoto Gyoen
species: Cherry, mixed single and double flowering on one tree (Prunus sp.)

location.neighbourhood: Near Seiho-mon gate, Kyoto Gyoen, Kamigyo-ku

verify_notes: Good story (Emperor Go-Mizunoo, r. 1611-1629, reportedly turned his carriage around to look at it again) but the current tree is a post-WWII graft propagated by nurseryman Sano Toujiro from shoots of the original, so it is at most about 80 years old, not the tree the legend describes. name: Chinkapin oak (Sudajii) of Omiya Gate, Kyoto Gyoen

location.neighbourhood: Near Omiya-gomon, south side of Kyoto Gyoen, Kamigyo-ku

verify_notes: Genuine Kamigyo Ward 'Pride Tree' (designated Oct 2008), 14.6m height, 2.78m girth, but single-sourced (the ward register only) with no age given and a moderate girth compared to this cluster's stronger candidates. Sits inside the same Gyoen cluster as kyo_006/011/012, so worth a second source hunt before it ships.

name: Camphor of Shimodachiuri Gate, Kyoto Gyoen

location.neighbourhood: Near Shimodachiuri-gomon, west side of Kyoto Gyoen, Kamigyo-ku

verify_notes: Kamigyo Ward 'Pride Tree', but modest for a camphor (12.3m height, 2.76m girth, well under Munakata Shrine's camphor a short walk away). Single-sourced, no age given. Same cluster, low priority relative to kyo_011/012/013/014.

name: Ginkgo of Inui Gate, Kyoto Gyoen

location.neighbourhood: Near Inui-gomon, northwest corner of Kyoto Gyoen, Kamigyo-ku

verify_notes: Kamigyo Ward 'Pride Tree', 19.5m height, 3.15m girth. Single-sourced, no age given, and geographically the far corner of the park (northwest), roughly 1.5-1.8km from the Demizu/Munakata anchor, which stretches the cluster rather than tightening it. Keep as a lead for a possible second Gyoen loop rather than folding into this walk.
